item.title: Version 0.2
item.description: Updates itself from now on. New: pick a date from a calendar or type one ("fri", "in 2 weeks"), a section suggested for each Inbox task, Settings in five places, prayer reminders before each time runs out, and faster typing. The app now counts how often it's used, never what you write; turn that off in Settings ▸ Rūznāma ▸ Share usage.
